rise.comparison_scope: Appearance-only clip flag versus publisher industrial-emission labels; no fire hazard, localization, event timing, negative exposure or real-time performance claim.

limitations: Primary event/box labels remain unreviewed: no precision/recall or false-alert-rate calculation
Time-lapse clips excluded from temporal scoring and camera-hour exposure
Public source training overlap unknown; one factory site and short clips are not independent production validation
Candidate event intervals merge gaps up to two seconds; event bounds do not mean a box appeared on every intervening frame
